ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The problem gives that in triangle ABC, A=30°, C=105°, b=4, and asks for side a. According to the sum of the interior angles of a triangle, B=180°-A-C=180°-30°-105°=45°. According to the standard notation of triangles, a is the side opposite angle A, and b is the side opposite angle B. By the sine theorem, a/sin A = b/sin B can be obtained, so a = b·sin A/sin B = 4·sin30°/sin45° = 4·(1/2)/(√2/2) = 2√2.

method.method_draft: Read the given triangle data: A=30°, C=105°, b=4, and the target is side a. First use the angle-sum rule to get B=180°-30°-105°=45°. method.method_draft: Read A=30°, C=105°, b=4, asking for a. Since b is side AC, take AC=4. Compute B=45°. Drop the altitude from C to AB, with foot D on AB. In right triangle ACD, AC=4 and angle A=30°, so CD=4sin30°=2. In right triangle BCD, angle B=45°, so it is a 45°-45°-90° right triangle, hence BD=CD=2. Therefore BC=a is the hypotenuse of a right triangle with legs 2 and 2, so a=√(2²+2²)=2√2.
method.CoT_raw: 已知三角形ABC中，A=30°，C=105°，b=4。按三角形常用记号，b是角B的对边，即AC=4。先求角B：B=180°-30°-105°=45°。按照指定方法，从C向AB作高，垂足为D。因为D在AB上，所以在直角三角形ACD中，AC=4为斜边，∠A=30°，于是CD=AC·sin30°=4×1/2=2。在直角三角形BCD中，∠B=45°，且∠D=90°，所以它是45°-45°-90°直角三角形，故BD=CD=2。因此BC=a为两直角边均为2的直角三角形的斜边，a=√(2²+2²)=√8=2√2。
